title: India Achieves Best-Ever Gold Haul at Para Games, Thulasimathi-Manasi Win Badminton Gold
indian_angle: Indian para-shuttlers Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra secured a gold medal, contributing to India's record-breaking medal tally at the Asian Para Games.
summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra won the women’s doubles SL3-SU5 title, giving India its 28th gold and pushing the nation past 100 medals for the first time at the Asian Para Games.

title: Ashmita Chaliha Stuns World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha achieved a significant career milestone by defeating the World No. 2, becoming only the second Indian to do so.
summary: The southpaw from Assam secured a 21-19, 21-18 victory over Akane Yamaguchi, marking a major upset and her biggest career win at the French Open.

title: Indian Kabaddi Teams Begin Commonwealth Championships with Resounding Wins
indian_angle: Both Indian men's and women's kabaddi teams started their Commonwealth Championships campaign with dominant victories.
summary: The Indian women's team crushed Malaysia 73-13, while the men's team defeated England 46-26, showcasing strong performances at the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championships.

title: Pratika's Unbeaten Century Secures Easy Win for India
indian_angle: Indian batter Pratika's outstanding unbeaten century led the national team to a comfortable victory.
summary: Pratika's commanding batting performance, including an unbeaten century, ensured a straightforward win for the Indian team.

title: India Wins Historic First Mixed Doubles Medal at Asian TT in 72 Years
indian_angle: An Indian mixed doubles pair secured the nation's first medal in the discipline at the Asian Table Tennis Championships in 72 years.
summary: The Indian duo overcame immense pressure, winning the decider 11-9 after losing the second and third games, to clinch a historic mixed doubles medal at the Asian Table Tennis Championships.
